name: cascade_delete
description: In `delete_customer` at `/api/customers/{c_custkey}`, child `Order` records are explicitly deleted via `db.query(Order).filter(Order.o_custkey == c_custkey).delete()` before the parent `Customer` is removed. The `monthly_trend` read endpoint depends on these `Order` rows to compute per-month aggregates, so deleting a customer permanently destroys order history that the trend endpoint expects to report.
